text: 10月23日，由中国钢铁工业协会主办、柳钢集团协办的2026年三季度部分钢铁企业经济运行座谈会在广西柳州召开。会上，来自中国宝武、鞍钢集团、河钢集团、首钢集团、沙钢集团等25家钢铁企业的有关负责人交流了前三季度企业的生产经营情况，探讨了行业目前面临的困难挑战，对四季度和后期行业形势进行了研判，并提出相关政策建议。钢协产业运行部、科技环保部、规划发展部、市场调研部、信息统计部相关同志对会上关切的产能治理、产量调控、钢材出口、数据治理、碳市场等问题进行了回应。对于今年四季度行业形势，多数代表认为“谨慎偏弱”。多数代表认为，四季度供需矛盾依然较大，国内钢铁市场
text_en: On October 23, the 2026 third-quarter economic operation symposium for some steel enterprises, hosted by the China Iron and Steel Association and co-organized by Liuzhou Iron and Steel Group, was held in Liuzhou, Guangxi. At the meeting, relevant executives from 25 steel enterprises including China Baowu, Ansteel Group, HBIS Group, Shougang Group and Shagang Group exchanged views on their production and operations in the first three quarters, discussed the difficulties and challenges currently facing the industry, assessed the industry situation for the fourth quarter and beyond, and put forward relevant policy recommendations. Relevant officials from the CISA's Industrial Operation Department, Science, Technology and Environmental Protection Department, Planning and Development Department, Market Research Department and Information and Statistics Department responded to issues of concern at the meeting, including capacity governance, output regulation, steel exports, data governance and the carbon market. Regarding the industry situation in the fourth quarter of this year, most representatives held a "cautiously weak" view.
